Directions Reduction

Codewars Télécharger le .py Énoncé original sur Codewars

Énoncé en bref

Simplifier un trajet en retirant les pas consécutifs qui s’annulent. Répéter jusqu’à obtenir le trajet réduit.

Code Python

def dirReduc(arr):
    path = ""
    for i in arr:
        path += i[0]
    arr = []
    while "EW" in path or "WE" in path or "SN" in path or "NS" in path:
        path = path.replace("EW", "")
        path = path.replace("WE", "")
        path = path.replace("SN", "")
        path = path.replace("NS", "")
    for i in path:
        if i == "N": arr.append("NORTH")
        if i == "S": arr.append("SOUTH")
        if i == "E": arr.append("EAST")
        if i == "W": arr.append("WEST")
    return arr

Exemple d’exécution

print(dirReduc(["WEST", "NORTH", "SOUTH", "EAST", "NORTH"]))
